translations.name: NJ Board of Public Utilities Customer Assistance
translations.description: The NJ Board of Public Utilities helps any utility customer. They enforce your rights, including a 12-month deferred payment plan, a 90-day hold on shutoffs for medical reasons, and no shutoffs from Friday to Sunday. Call 1-800-624-0241, 9am-4pm.
translations.website_description: Learn about housing and utility help.
